200.body: New Polish constitutional court judge takes oath in defiance of president Oct 14, 2026 | Featured , Law , Politics Keep our news free from ads and paywalls by making a donation to support our work! The standoff between the government and opposition-aligned President Karol Nawrocki over Poland’s Constitutional Tribunal (TK) deepened today, as Maciej Berek, whom Prime Minister Donald Tusk recently described as his “right-hand man”, took his oath as a new judge without the presence of the president. PILNE 🚨 dr Maciej Berek złożył w Sejmie ślubowanie na sędziego Trybunału Konstytucyjnego! pic.twitter.com/sZlzLnsL3M — Bogdan Zdrojewski (@BZdrojewski) October 14, 2026 Under Polish law, a new TK judge must swear an oath “before the president”. It added that, if the president refuses to receive a judge’s oath, they are justified in taking it without him being present.

A 66-year-old Polish man has been charged with planning an attack on Prime Minister Donald Tusk as part of an attempt to overthrow the government.
200.body: Man charged with plotting attack on Polish PM Oct 13, 2026 | Law Keep our news free from ads and paywalls by making a donation to support our work! A 66-year-old Polish man has been charged with planning an attack on Prime Minister Donald Tusk as part of an attempt to overthrow the government. The suspect, who can be named only as Krzysztof N. under Polish privacy law, has also been charged with a number of other offences, including promoting a war of aggression in Ukraine and inciting hate crimes. Another newspaper, Rzeczpospolita , found that he runs a Facebook page called Radical Polish Resistance Movement that has almost 8,000 followers and claims Poland’s two main political parties – Tusk’s centrist Civic Coalition (KO) and the national-conservative opposition Law and Justice (PiS) – are “in the hands of globalists and Judeo-communists”.

200.body: News World Polish Justice Minister Żurek suspends three judges from duties — RMF24 UA.NEWS 14 October 2026 11:58 --> In Poland, Justice Minister Waldemar Żurek decided to immediately suspend judges Michał Lasota, Piotr Schab and Przemysław W. As RMF24 reports , the Ministry of Justice said the decision was related to a justified suspicion that they had committed acts prohibited by law, as well as the need to protect the authority of the court and important service interests. The suspension will be in effect for up to one month The orders for an immediate break in the performance of official duties were issued on the basis of motions by Poland's National Prosecutor's Office to adopt decisions that would allow the judges to be held criminally liable. According to the ministry, after being dismissed from the post of deputy disciplinary commissioner for judges of ordinary courts in July 2025, he claimed that he still held the position and carried out actions falling within its powers.

300.body: News / Trading Economics / Poland Inflation Rate at 15-Month High Poland Inflation Rate at 15-Month High Less than 1 min read PLIRYY The annual inflation rate in Poland rose to 4.1% in September 2026, slightly above the preliminary estimate and up from 3.4% in the previous month. This marked the highest reading since June 2025, as prices accelerated for housing and utilities (5.1% vs. 5.4%), while inflation held steady for personal hygiene, social protection, and other goods and services at 2.4%. On a monthly basis, consumer prices rose by 0.7% in September, following a 0.3% increase in August.

500.body: 18 that its artificial intelligence, Gemini, had hacked into three companies while undergoing testing back in May, according to The New York Times . During the test, Gemini suddenly found public information online that allowed it access to the three companies, CNN reported . In each of the incidents, Gemini had been tasked with attacking a fictional company, but when the fictional companies shared names with real-life companies and internet access was unintentionally provided, the hacks occurred, according to The New York Times . 19, Irregular reported that “it informed Google and all affected entities back in July as part of its investigation,” and that “all known issues on our end were remedied and resolved weeks ago.” However, Google reportedly did not learn about the Gemini company hacks until as late as July, when Irregular checked for incidents in its work, according to NBC News .

500.title: Unfair competition in AI agent commerce
500.summary: CBLJ Featured Correspondents Joint-Win Law Firm Unfair competition in AI agent commerce By Zhang Yichen and Zhu Hongjian, Joint-Win Partners 14 October 2026 0 13 T he battleground for competition is shifting from human attention to AI interpretation and recommendation.
500.body: CBLJ Featured Correspondents Joint-Win Law Firm Unfair competition in AI agent commerce By Zhang Yichen and Zhu Hongjian, Joint-Win Partners 14 October 2026 0 13 T he battleground for competition is shifting from human attention to AI interpretation and recommendation. Unfair competition red lines Measures, such as optimising the structure of a corporate website, refining product specifications and building authoritative knowledge sources to enable AI systems to read a brand more accurately, remain, in essence, forms of legitimate competition. Even so, as AI visibility emerges as a new competitive resource, the relevant conduct must still be assessed within the basic framework of the Anti-Unfair Competition Law (AUCL). As GEO becomes more embedded in corporate marketing systems, competition compliance must move beyond reviewing the final content and extend to how content is produced, how instructions are conveyed and how conduct is carried out.

500.title: Neura Robotics launches multimodal AI model that gives robots perception and memory
500.summary: Neura Robotics launches multimodal AI model that gives robots perception and memory October 14, 2026 by Sam Francis Neura Robotics has launched Neuron AI, its multimodal foundation model for physical AI.
500.body: Neura Robotics launches multimodal AI model that gives robots perception and memory October 14, 2026 by Sam Francis Neura Robotics has launched Neuron AI, its multimodal foundation model for physical AI. Combining 3D vision, touch, audio, robot state and language with memory, Neuron AI enables robots to act on information beyond what cameras alone can capture, as well as retain relevant context when objects disappear from view. Three data pillars Trained on three complementary sources of physical experience: Real-world robot data: Robots across different embodiments perform tasks in Neura Gyms, Neura’s training infrastructure for cognitive robots and Physical AI and real-world environments, generating synchronized vision, touch, force, audio and movement data. Neura brings together the robots, hands, sensing technology, data infrastructure and AI development needed to connect model training with physical performance.

600.title: Iga Swiatek Wins All-Polish Battle In Straight Sets To Reach R16 At Wuhan Open
600.summary: Six-time Grand Slam champion Iga Swiatek launched her Wuhan Open campaign by triumphing 6-2, 6-1 in an all-Polish battle against lucky loser Magdalena Frech on Wednesday. Swiatek posted her 40th victory of the season in one hour and 42 minutes and remains on course for a potential quarter-final showdown with top seed and three-time Wuhan winner Aryna Sabalenka.
600.body: Six-time Grand Slam champion Iga Swiatek launched her Wuhan Open campaign by triumphing 6-2, 6-1 in an all-Polish battle against lucky loser Magdalena Frech on Wednesday. Swiatek posted her 40th victory of the season in one hour and 42 minutes and remains on course for a potential quarter-final showdown with top seed and three-time Wuhan winner Aryna Sabalenka. “We know each other pretty well, so I just wanted to focus on being consistent and playing as good as possible,” Swiatek, the seventh seed, said of Frech. Despite the lopsided scoreline the opening set was tight, lasting over an hour and requiring Swiatek to erase a 0-2 deficit and save seven of eight break points before she finally took the lead on her fourth set point.
